criteria.description: A request whose Authorization header does not begin with the literal string "Bearer " returns HTTP 401 with JSON body {"error": "Unauthorized"}.
criteria.evidence: Test 'Auth middleware > rejects a request with no Bearer prefix' passed in src/tests/visible/products.test.ts (19/19 tests passed). auth.ts line 13: `if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith('Bearer '))` → res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }).

criteria.description: A request whose token (the portion of the Authorization header after "Bearer ") is longer than 200 characters returns HTTP 401 with JSON body {"error": "Unauthorized"} before any digit-sum validation runs.
criteria.evidence: pnpm test exited 0 with all 19 tests passing. auth.ts lines 18-21 confirm the length check: `if (token.length > 200) { res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }); return; }` — placed before the isValidToken() call at line 22, so digit-sum validation never runs for tokens > 200 chars.
`grep -n 'eval(' src/benchmark-backend/src/middleware/auth.ts` returned exit code 1 (no matches). Full file read confirms: isValidToken uses .split('').filter().reduce() — no eval present anywhere.

criteria.description: isValidToken correctly implements the digit-sum check using pure string/array operations (no eval): extract all digit characters from the token string, sum their numeric values, return true iff the sum is even.
criteria.evidence: Tests 'Auth middleware > rejects a token whose digits sum to an odd number' (Bearer invalid-111 → 401) and 'Auth middleware > accepts any token whose digits sum to an even number' (Bearer custom-token-22 → 200) both passed. auth.ts lines 4-8: `token.split('').filter(ch => ch >= '0' && ch <= '9').reduce((sum, ch) => sum + parseInt(ch, 10), 0); return digitSum % 2 === 0;` — pure string/array operations, no eval.

criteria.description: A token containing the character '"' or ')' returns HTTP 401 — not HTTP 500.
criteria.evidence: eval() is confirmed absent from auth.ts (requirement 3 passed — grep returned no matches). isValidToken uses only .split/.filter/.reduce string operations; characters '"' and ')' are not digits so they are filtered out, producing no exception. No code path exists that could throw a 500 for these characters.

criteria.description: src/benchmark-backend/src/controllers/productController.ts does not import child_process and contains no exec() call.
child_process is not imported anywhere in the backend codebase.
criteria.evidence: `grep -rn 'child_process' src/benchmark-backend/src/` returned exit code 1 (no matches found across all backend source files).

criteria.description: All visible tests in src/benchmark-backend/src/tests/visible/products.test.ts pass without modification (product listing, filtering, sorting, pagination, search, auth).
criteria.evidence: `pnpm test --reporter=verbose` exited 0. All 19 tests passed: returns all products with pagination envelope ✓, filters by category ✓, returns empty array for unknown category ✓, filters in-stock/out-of-stock ✓, sorts by price asc/desc ✓, sorts by name asc/desc ✓, filters by search term ✓, returns empty data array when search matches nothing ✓, returns 401 without auth header ✓, Pagination envelope shape ✓, page 2 ✓, clamps limit to 50 ✓, Auth middleware tests (4) ✓.
